supersedes: Any previous instruction that treated Clear Weather as an unapproved or pending scene.
scope: Weather Live Art artwork production only; no renderer or view changes.

masterFirstWorkflow.principle: The approved artwork is the only visual source of truth. The Live asset is a faithful drawing-data reproduction of that artwork, not a second design.
steps: Preserve the exact approved source master byte-for-byte.
Inspect the current artwork schema, catalogue, and renderer before tracing.
Trace the approved master itself; do not generate or redesign an alternate Live composition.
Preserve silhouettes, proportions, negative spaces, brush edges, tonal details, and meaningful small marks.
Define a scene-specific path order from the approved master.
Encode using the existing ordered-ink-wash-paths schema and 1000x700 coordinate system.
Reconstruct a preview and compare it with the source master at full composition and card scale.
Validate palette indexes, path decoding, coordinate bounds, path order, and catalogue linkage.
If an important detail cannot be represented, document it and seek a technical decision rather than silently simplifying.
Package the artwork, catalogue update, master source, preview, and hashes without claiming deployment.

clearWeatherArtwork.redAccents: Preserve multiple source vermilion tones and paper-coloured texture gaps; do not flatten to a single solid red.
clearWeatherArtwork.compositionRule: Preserve the supplied master exactly; do not add, remove, rearrange, crop, stretch, or reinterpret its elements.
clearWeatherArtwork.fidelityNote: The untouched master JPEG is the source of truth. The ordered-path asset is a contour-based reproduction within the current renderer's capabilities, not a pixel-identical raster. The current renderer supplies its own paper ground and cannot reproduce every JPEG paper-grain pixel. Any exact-raster renderer feature requires a separate explicit technical decision.

protectedBoundaries: Do not edit the Rain artwork or its drawing sequence.
Do not change the shared drawing engine, path decoder, painting algorithm, or Replay timing.
Allow only the narrow Clear Weather selection-routing patch specified in rendererSelectionPatch.
Do not change the 10:7 Live Art card, title/caption/status/Replay overlays, or other Weather UI.
Do not change network, cache, offline/recovery, service-worker, or app-shell behaviour.
Do not modify Home, Earth, Moon, Sun, or any other app view.

rendererSelectionPatch.purpose: Allow the existing renderer to select the clear-weather catalogue record.
changes: Add clear to the allowed weather-selection list.
Preserve raw weather tags in the prepared artwork object.
Use a weather-aware active-artwork check instead of a Rain-specific ID check.
Use a generic weather-scene canvas accessibility label.
explicitlyUnchanged: Other Weather UI and all unrelated app views
